_about: Where each outdoor land lies on the one continent, in world cells: the world cell its south-west cell sits on (x east, y north, as a map's own columns and rows run). Lands a road joins touch along that edge and the road meets itself across the border; borders without a road are walled off, and where no land lies are the wilds. Laid out by tools/world_layout.py; check_content.py checks it still fits maps.json.
